title: Lost Mary BM6000 Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The Lost Mary BM6000 Bundle is designed for extended enjoyment and endless flexibility, offering a comprehensive package that includes two complete Lost Mary BM6000 Prefilled Vape Kits plus an additional Extra Pod. This "V2 edition" setup ensures you have ample battery life and e-liquid capacity to last, allowing you to keep a backup device ready or switch between flavours instantly. Each kit in the bundle features an innovative automatic refill system, combining a prefilled 2ml pod with a 10ml refill container to deliver up to 6000 puffs. The device is powered by a substantial 1000mAh rechargeable battery, which is detachable for easy recycling. With an OLED display to track battery life and a visible e-liquid window, the BM6000 offers a seamless and user-friendly experience. Inside, Lost Mary’s Mesh coil technology enhances vapour production and flavour consistency, ensuring a rich vape from start to finish. Preloaded with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid, the system provides a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Available Flavours: The Lost Mary BM6000 collection offers a variety of vibrant profiles. You can enjoy the smooth and sweet notes of Summer Grape, or explore other popular options in the range such as refreshing Pineapple Ice, zesty Pink Lemonade, and the rich, fruity blend of Blueberry Sour Raspberry. How To Set Up Your Lost Mary BM6000 Device Step 1 Remove the device and e-liquid refill bottle from the packaging. Step 2 Remove the safety stickers and the lid of the refill bottle (do not remove the rubber cover). Step 3 Remove the plug where the refill container meets the pod. Step 4 Insert the bottle upwards into the side of the device until it sits flush. Step 5 Turn the device upside down to fill the 2ml tank chamber. Step 6 Leave to stand for several minutes to allow the coil to saturate. Step 7 Inhale to vape. ✅ Ready to vape
